Defect: Repeated letters produced phantom yellow tiles
Root cause: indexOf() always matched the first occurrence, so a repeated guess letter was flagged more times than it appears in the answer
Fix: Rewritten as a two-pass WordleEngine

Defect: Board rendered with zero rows
Root cause: Kotlin property init order: attempts was declared after _uiState, so freshState() read 0
Fix: Moved the declaration above _uiState

Defect: Progress would strand past level 20
Root cause: MAX_LEVEL hardcoded to 20 in UnlockManager and CompletedManager
Fix: Driven from LevelProvider.levelCount

Defect: POST attempt failed on levels 21-27
Root cause: levels table only held 20 rows and attempts/unlocks have foreign keys to it
Fix: Migration 002 seeds levels 21-27

Defect: Replaying a solved dish awarded points and new badges
Root cause: Gamification had no record of pre-Module-2 solves, so replays looked like new wins
Fix: ensureSeeded plus a solvedLevels guard; failing test written first

Defect: Points displayed 0 after the replay fix
Root cause: Seeding claimed its flag but awarded no points and never evaluated badges
Fix: Retroactive BASE_POINTS credit plus grantOwedBadges

Defect: Same account showed different points on a second device
Root cause: No read path existed; the client only ever pushed progress
Fix: get_progress.php plus a server-wins refresh

Defect: Dish count stuck at 0 until leaving and returning
Root cause: remember(Session.userId) snapshotted prefs once, before the async sync landed
Fix: Screens read the reactive gamification flow

Defect: Points spent on power-ups were refunded
Root cause: spendPoints wrote locally and never pushed; the server-wins refresh restored the old balance
Fix: Spending routed through GamificationCoordinator.spend, which debits and pushes

Defect: Leaving a round discarded the board
Root cause: Round state lived only in the ViewModel, which is cleared on navigation
Fix: SavedRound plus RoundStateRepository persisted to SharedPreferences

Defect: Back from the dish page replayed the win screen
Root cause: PROCEED pushed the dish page without removing the finished game destination
Fix: Every exit pops the game entry; launchSingleTop on return

Defect: Region panel covered the pin it described
Root cause: Popup sat at the top of the map, exactly where the Luzon pin is
Fix: Progress and region detail share one slot below the map

Defect: Explore header scrolled under the status bar
Root cause: Header was inside the scrolling Column
Fix: Only the body scrolls now

Defect: Any client could write any account: points, badges, profile
Root cause: Endpoints read user_id from the request body, so identity was a claim rather than a credential
Fix: Bearer tokens; kk_require_user() derives identity and ignores the body user_id

Defect: users.role missing though it is in the shared User contract
Root cause: Never added when the contract was agreed
Fix: Migration 004 adds role ENUM(player, admin)

Defect: Existing installs would 401 silently after the auth change
Root cause: Stored sessions predate tokens: a user_id with no way to authenticate it
Fix: SessionStore treats a tokenless session as signed out

Defect: post_attempt / post_unlock / get_unlocks / get_profile_stats still accept a spoofed user_id
Root cause: Left open deliberately because the ASP.NET dashboard calls them and would start failing
Fix: Needs KusinaApiClient.cs to send a token first — coordinate with the Module 5 owner

Defect: Raw exception text shown to the player on a failed login
Root cause: Errors were surfaced as e.message, so Ktor's "Connect timeout has expired [url=http://192.168.100.21/...]" went straight to the screen in red
Fix: AppError classification plus an ErrorNotice component; raw text moved behind a Details toggle

Defect: App cannot reach the server after changing network
Root cause: KusinaApi.BASE is a hard-coded LAN IP (192.168.100.21), so it only works on the network the server sits on
Fix: Interim: make the base URL configurable at runtime. Real fix: the Azure host in Module 6 cloud integration

Defect: Password reset OTP returned in the API response — full account takeover
Root cause: $APP_DEBUG was hard-coded true in request_password_reset.php, so anyone who knew an email could read the reset code from the JSON and change that password
Fix: Off by default via KK_EXPOSE_RESET_CODE, and additionally refused unless the caller is on localhost

Defect: No rate limiting or lockout on login or OTP verification
Root cause: Nothing counted failed attempts, so passwords and 6-digit reset codes could be guessed without limit
Fix: auth_attempts table; throttled per identifier and per IP, before any account lookup so lockout is not an enumeration oracle

Defect: Register confirmed which email addresses have accounts
Root cause: "Username or email already registered" turned sign-up into an account checker
Fix: Username collisions still reported plainly (public on the leaderboard); email collisions get a generic refusal

Defect: Database internals returned to clients
Root cause: Four endpoints echoed 'PDO: ' . getMessage(), naming tables and columns
Fix: kk_fail() logs the real error server-side and returns a generic message

Defect: Bearer token recoverable via ADB backup and readable on a rooted device
Root cause: android:allowBackup was true and the token sat in plain SharedPreferences
Fix: allowBackup=false; EncryptedSharedPreferences with a Keystore-backed key, migrating any existing plaintext session

Defect: Signing out left the token valid for its full 30 days
Root cause: Logout only cleared the device copy; nothing revoked it server-side, so a captured token kept working
Fix: logout.php revokes the calling token (or all sessions with ?all=1); the app calls it on sign-out

Defect: Every ranked player shows Bronze — Gold and Silver are unreachable
How found: Code review during the web Clean Architecture refactor
Root cause: Tier thresholds are Gold>=2000 / Silver>=1000, but the dashboard passes a count of correct attempts, which across 27 dishes tops out in the dozens (highest in the live DB is 35). The thresholds suit the mobile points scale, where that same player has 2375.
Fix: Behaviour preserved and pinned by tests in KusinaKode.Domain.Tests. Fix is a team decision: rescale the thresholds to the attempt count, or feed the dashboard the mobile points instead.

Defect: Solving a new dish did not add +10 KK (wallet stayed at daily 5)
Root cause: +10 depended on post_progress seeing rounds_completed go up. A first solve of Lechon (level 1) was often already in CompletedManager so it looked like a replay and never minted. Now the first correct attempt for a dish mints +10 via post_attempt.php.
Fix: First correct attempt per level_id fires round_win +10; client settles the tx_ref before refreshing the wallet

Defect: Claiming a badge does not refresh the badge shelf - Profile still reads 'pending' until the app is restarted
How found: Play testing on a live claim
Root cause: RewardsViewModel.refresh() only refreshes the Rewards screen. GamificationCoordinator.refresh() - the only path that re-fetches tx_hash - runs solely in GamificationViewModel.init, and that ViewModel survives navigation
Fix: ChainRewardCoordinator refreshes the gamification coordinator after a confirmed mint, and RewardsViewModel does the same after a manual claim, so the badge shelf flips pending -> verified without an app restart

Defect: PHP EC key generation fails on Windows XAMPP, so no custodial wallet can ever be created and every badge stays pending
Root cause: kk_ec_generate() calls openssl_pkey_new() with no 'config' fallback. PHP's compiled default points at C:/Program Files/Common Files/SSL/openssl.cnf which does not exist, and XAMPP's httpd-xampp.conf SetEnv names C:/xampp/apache/bin/openssl.cnf which XAMPP does not ship - SetEnv does not reach the OpenSSL library in any case
Fix: Workaround: set the OPENSSL_CONF user env var and fully restart the XAMPP Control Panel. Proper fix is a config fallback in kk_ec_generate() plus a line in READ_ME_FIRST

Defect: Hardhat contract suite could not run on any machine, not only the Mac without Node
Root cause: hardhat.config.js set paths.sources to '.', so Hardhat scanned the folder root recursively and tripped HH1006 on the stray .sol files inside node_modules (eth-gas-reporter mocks and Hardhat sample projects)
Fix: Sources moved to contracts/src/ and paths.sources updated; suite now runs 5 passing, 0 failing

Defect: Two rewards in flight at once both fail with 'Chain failed to sync after append', so the KK is never credited
How found: Auto-minting badges surfaced it: winning a dish fires the round reward plus every badge it unlocks in the same instant
Root cause: kk_chain_append builds a block's index and prev_hash in Phase 2 but appends it in Phase 3, a separate request. Concurrent rewards both read the same chain tip, both claim the same index, and kk_chain_sync_ok() then rejects the chain. LOCK_EX on file_put_contents guards the single write, not the read-modify-write across the two phases
Fix: Client mitigated with ChainQueue, a mutex serialising every chain write from one device (round wins, badge mints, island claims, power-up and shop spends). Local chain repaired with api/tools/repair_chain.php (renumbers, re-chains and re-signs the blocks the race corrupted) and 7 stranded rewards resumed with api/tools/retry_failed.php - 6 confirmed, 1 legitimately short of KK. STILL NOT FIXED: two devices playing at once collide, which is what the G-07 stress pass does. The append must become atomic server-side, re-deriving index/prev_hash from the live tip under a lock. Alyssa's module - consensus code deliberately untouched

Defect: A reward that fails once is stranded forever - it cannot resume and cannot be re-claimed, so the KK is silently lost
How found: Chasing D-31: badges sat on 'still settling on-chain' with no way forward
Root cause: kk_pipeline_advance returns early when status is 'failed', so there is no resume path, while reward_claims already holds a row for the attempt so the claim gate refuses a retry
Fix: api/tools/retry_failed.php rewinds stranded records to Phase 1 and walks them home one at a time. That is an operator tool, not a product fix - the pipeline still has no automatic retry, and a player cannot recover their own reward

Defect: Login lockout was shared by IP so 8 fails on one account locked every other account on the same phone
Root cause: kk_enforce_throttle() counted identifier = :i OR ip_address = :ip with the same cap of 8
Fix: Login counts fails per email/username only. Register reset and reward still use identifier or IP. Message unchanged. Still throttled before user lookup. Success still clears only that identifier.

Defect: Buying a chef in Chef's Atelier returned Unknown shop item
Root cause: Live XAMPP REST/lib/shop.php still listed old hats and had no avc_* chef ids. POST reward/spend.php falls through kk_power_up_cost then kk_shop_price, which throws Unknown shop item. Web_KusinaKode/api/lib/shop.php already had the chefs.
Fix: Copied the full shop catalogue onto both live XAMPP REST/lib/shop.php paths so chef and frame ids match KusinaShop.kt. Avatar confirm button is Buy / Buying… instead of Unlock.

Defect: KODEX hub DISHES stack showed five hardcoded dishes even when the player had not solved them
Root cause: KodexHubScreen built the carousel from a fixed list of adobo/sinigang/paksiw/sisig/mechado instead of solvedLevels
Fix: Hub now lists solved dishes only (up to five). An empty card tells the player to solve a dish before pictures appear.

Defect: KODEX Pantry baul overlay crashed the app (IndexOutOfBoundsException in Compose Stack.pop)
Root cause: PantryDrawOverlay returned early from the Box when OPEN ALL produced a haul, so the composer group stack did not match on recompose
Fix: Haul and choose/open beats now use if/else with no early return. The haul pager has a fixed height.

Defect: Win music died before the CORRECT! screen
Root cause: bg_win and bg_win_first were one-shots and released on completion during the heritage card and palayok
Fix: Win beds now loop through the card pot and CORRECT! and stop only on Next Level or Back to Map.

Defect: DRAW 1 on the pantry palayok overlay flickered then showed the ingredient
Root cause: Tapping DRAW 1 swapped ChooseGrid for OpeningBeat then a nested Dialog; when the draw finished the Choose screen also flashed back for a frame before the reveal card
Fix: Pantry DRAW 1 stays on the same palayok until the result is ready then shows the reveal in-place. Rarity badge no longer sits on a cream circle.

Defect: Story film froze on Tap anywhere to continue after the last frame
Root cause: setOnCompletionListener only raised a tap door instead of leaving the screen
Fix: Completion and playback errors now leave immediately. Replay from Home pops back; first sign-up still continues into the practice round.

Defect: Skip on the practice round advanced the chef line instead of leaving
Root cause: ChefDialogue is a full-screen clickable overlay drawn above Skip so the tap never reached onSkip
Fix: Tutorial top bar (Skip and Back) is drawn above the chef overlay and swallows header taps.

Defect: Home bell showed 1 while WAITING FOR YOU listed two rows
Root cause: Inbox splits the daily into KK plus a palayok spin; the bell counted dailyClaimable as 1
Fix: waitingForYouCount treats an unclaimed daily as 2 and also counts leftover palayok spins.

Defect: Resume on the pause overlay had two orange blotches on the right
Root cause: pause_btn_resume.png baked leftover motif dots into the terracotta pill
Fix: Pause and leave actions are Compose HUD pills with Be Vietnam Pro ExtraBold and circular icon wells; PNG labels retired.

Defect: Reward report labelled details optional then failed on submit and still showed Done
Root cause: Details were sent blank and Done stayed under Cancel/Submit
Fix: Report details are required; Done hides while filing. Copy report/submit.php into XAMPP REST if the send still 404s.

Defect: GET pantry/snapshot.php 404ed on the emulator so the pantry overlay dumped Apache HTML
Root cause: Live XAMPP REST had no pantry/ folder; Ktor then tried to decode the 404 HTML as JSON
Fix: Copied pantry/ report/ and lib pantry helpers into htdocs REST. Snapshot and report now 401 JSON without a token. getPantrySnapshot no longer throws the HTML body.

Defect: Ledger ticket report accepted junk details like aaa
Root cause: Client and submit.php only rejected a blank message
Fix: ReportDetails requires 12+ characters with real words; PHP kk_report_details_error matches.

Defect: Complete Philippines 6/6 showed +15 KK with no CLAIMED chip and no notification
Root cause: RemoteGamificationSync auto-claimed island KK in the background so Rewards never showed CLAIM/CLAIMED; live XAMPP islands.php had no philippines set so earn.php never marked it claimable
Fix: Islands wait for a CLAIM tap like Daily Login; CLAIMED chip; waiting and claimed notifications; local 6/6 marks claimable; copied Web islands.php (with philippines) onto both XAMPP REST/lib paths

Defect: After claiming Daily Login on Rewards, inbox still showed Daily claim ready plus Palayok spin waiting
Root cause: Notifications kept a stale earn snapshot on back; waiting listed Free palayok spin and Palayok spin waiting together; then Daily palayok spin was also drawn onto the daily_login ledger before the wheel was spun
Fix: Refresh earn and pantry on resume; one Daily palayok spin waiting row until the wheel is turned; On-Chain Activity lists only the claimed Daily KK

Defect: Spinning the daily palayok never appeared under On-Chain Activity
Root cause: pantry/spin.php only updated the pantry bank; no palayok_spin receipt was written so history.php had nothing to list
Fix: spin.php triggers palayok_spin at 0 KK and advances to confirmed; inbox labels Daily palayok spin with +N palayoks and refreshes history when the wheel lands

Defect: Sell on the post-win palayok card did nothing
Root cause: The full-screen keep-it clickable sat on the parent Box so the sell tap dismissed the card instead of selling
Fix: Keep-it is a behind scrim; sell is a compact Button that consumes the tap and the overlay closes when the sale finishes.

Defect: Chef's Vault TRADING overlay showed an empty stall with no ingredients
Root cause: Jars were drawn behind the boarded stall and only during a one-shot Animatable so they never read as coming into the vault
Fix: Stall is nearly full-width; ingredients loop in from the sides and up from the pantry in front of the boards until the payout.

Defect: DRAW 1 flashed the palayok in from the left of the pantry overlay
Root cause: OpeningBeat started travel at 0 so a pantry solo pot (grid seat 0) sat one frame off the left before snapping to centre
Fix: Solo ritual starts already centred; OPEN ALL uses the same shake then the haul cards.
